answer: Each identity must present a nonce-bound hardware attestation quote from a sealed key unique to one physical node: rigs in shale fields, sensors on basalt, edge boxes in a meadow. One key maps to one identity; re-registering the same silicon fails. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 distinct nodes, each locking a 20,000 POA bond: 20,000,000 POA frozen, versus one honest 20,000 POA bond refunded at settlement. Enforcement: a cluster sharing a node key, or a replayed quote, is slashed 100 percent, half burned, half to the reporter, plus a 10-epoch ban. Limitation: chip scarcity centralizes power.
